title: Privacy, Security, and Policy
summary: HIPAA Privacy and Security Rules, HITECH, the 21st Century Cures Act, the ONC information blocking rule, and the security control families the boards expect you to know cold.
learningOutcomes: State the categories of HIPAA Privacy Rule protections and Security Rule safeguards (administrative, physical, technical).
Explain HITECH's additions on top of HIPAA, especially breach notification.
List the eight information-blocking exceptions under the 21st Century Cures Act and apply them to a scenario.
Distinguish authentication, authorization, audit, and accounting in the context of an EHR.
Read a breach scenario and identify which rule was violated and what the response should be.
